name: policy-dev
description: One command runs the whole pipeline: /policy-dev <task> with an optional human demo video. Stages: preflight, video to hurobo demonstration data (markers required), DemoSpec JSON, prompt, Synthesizer (program, develop-and-repair on one acceptance seed), Adversary loop (attack, diagnose, rewrite, gate). Plain data: any agent can read these defaults and limits; the Studio server reads them from this file. Bowl-on-plate only. Muse tokens cost about $13.5 per million.

extraction.note: Only clips of the ArUco/ChArUco marker setup can be extracted. Marker size is the measured 5.75 cm; the stored demospecs used 6.0 cm.

budget.note: Budgets are checked before each model call, so one call can overshoot; each stage therefore keeps one call of headroom below the total.
